findings.summary: TRUMP MEME COIN LAUNCH TIMING: TRUMP token launched Jan 17, 2025 — exactly 3 days before inauguration (Jan 20). Token hit market cap of ~73B within 48 hours before crashing. MELANIA token launched Jan 18, further diluting TRUMP holders. By launch, CIC Digital LLC and Fight Fight Fight LLC held 800M of 1B tokens (80%). Per Canary TRUMP Coin ETF S-1/A (SEC Registration 333-289857), Fight Fight Fight LLC is owned by CIC Digital LLC and Celebration Cards LLC. The 6 insider wallet groups have staggered 3-month unlock schedules, with first unlock Apr 18, 2025. All trading fees flow to CIC Digital and Celebration Cards. The pre-inauguration timing ensured maximum speculative demand before presidential power was assumed.
findings.detail: From Canary Capital Group S-1/A filed Feb 13, 2026: Token Creator Affiliates (CIC Digital + Celebration Cards) initially owned 800M tokens (80%). Creator Affiliates receive transaction fees. 6 insider wallet groups with distinct unlock schedules starting 3 months post-launch. Token on Solana blockchain via Meteora liquidity pool. Initial liquidity: 200M tokens (20%) in pool with SOL. CIC Digital LLC is described as 'an affiliate of President Trump' in multiple SEC filings. Fight Fight Fight LLC formed specifically for this token (name references Trump's reaction after assassination attempt July 2024).

findings.summary: TRUMP MEME COIN GALA: Trump hosted black-tie dinner May 22, 2025 at Virginia golf club for top 220 TRUMP token holders who spent combined 148M. Top holder was Justin Sun (Chinese crypto mogul facing SEC fraud charges that were PAUSED citing public interest). 19 of top 25 holders likely foreign nationals per Bloomberg. 35 House Democrats demanded DOJ investigation for potential bribery and foreign emoluments violations. Trump family earned 320M+ in trading fees since Jan launch. 764,000 wallets of small holders lost money. GD Culture Group (Chinese ties) announced 300M TRUMP purchase after Trump signaled TikTok ban delay.

findings.detail: Per Canary TRUMP Coin ETF S-1/A (SEC Registration No. 333-289857, filed Feb 13, 2026): Trump Organization-affiliated entities CIC Digital LLC and Fight Fight Fight LLC collectively initially owned 800,000,000 tokens across six wallet groups labeled 'Creators & CIC Digital 1-6.' Fight Fight Fight LLC is owned by CIC Digital LLC and Celebration Cards LLC. Both receive trading revenue derived from TRUMP trading. Unlock schedule: Group 1 (36%) - 3mo cliff + 24mo linear; Group 2 (18%) - 6mo cliff + 24mo linear; Group 3 (18%) - 12mo cliff + 24mo linear. This means the Trump Organization retains 80% of all TRUMP meme coin supply and earns ongoing trading fees. At the peak price, the insider allocation was worth billions.

findings.summary: GD CULTURE GROUP — CHINESE-LINKED 300M TRUMP COIN PURCHASE: GD Culture Group (Nasdaq-listed, Chinese ties, 8 employees, zero revenue, operates TikTok store) announced 300M investment in Bitcoin and TRUMP meme coin. Funded by stock sale to unnamed BVI entity. Creates direct conflict: Trump family profits from Chinese-linked purchase while Trump negotiates TikTok ban with China. Company essentially a shell — no revenue, 8 employees — yet secured 300M from anonymous offshore investor specifically to buy Trump-branded crypto. Reps Casten and Smith cited this in DOJ investigation demand.
findings.detail: GD Culture Group SEC filing confirms 300M investment plan. Company trades on Nasdaq despite: (1) 8 employees, (2) zero revenue, (3) business model dependent on TikTok (Chinese platform facing US ban). The 300M comes from stock sale to unnamed BVI (British Virgin Islands) entity — classic offshore opacity. The timing coincides with Trump's TikTok negotiations. This is a potential foreign influence channel: anonymous Chinese-linked capital flows into Trump family crypto assets via a Nasdaq-listed shell, creating financial incentive for Trump to be favorable on TikTok policy. Pattern mirrors the UAE channel via Aryam/MGX.
